title: participant
description: Values schema for the `participant` umbrella chart. Validates the `global.*` contract that an external Argo CD values repository is expected to supply per participant/environment. Per-component sections are intentionally left permissive here: their own irreducible required values (image tags, secret names, etc.) are enforced at render time via Helm's `required` function in each subchart, which gives more precise/contextual error messages than JSON schema can.

global.description: Values shared across every subchart. This is the primary values surface an external Argo CD values repository needs to supply per participant/environment.

participantName.description: Participant short name, used to derive release names, the default vault folder, vault token secret name, DID paths, and OTEL tenant_id.

environment.description: Deployment environment name (e.g. dev/test/prod), used in the generated OTEL deployment.environment attribute.

useHttps.description: Whether public-facing URLs derived by the charts should use https.

db.description: Shared PostgreSQL connection primitives used to derive each component's JDBC URL.

serverFqdn.description: Fully qualified hostname of the shared PostgreSQL server.

name.description: Database name shared by all components (each component uses its own schema within it).
Name of the Kubernetes secret containing the shared PostgreSQL credentials, used by control-plane, data-plane, identity-hub, and telemetry-agent when their own component-level secret name is not set.

image.description: Primitives used to derive each component's image repository.

vaultProvider.description: Vault provider used in derived image repository names. "hashicorp" and "azure" map to the published "hashicorpvault" and "azurevault" image suffixes; explicit suffixes are also accepted.

keys.description: Shared vault key aliases used by data-plane, identity-hub, and telemetry-agent when their own component-level alias is not set.

privateKeyAlias.description: Vault alias of the shared private key (Terraform's `privatekey_alias`, equal to the participant/authority name itself with no suffix) used by data-plane, identity-hub, and telemetry-agent's credential manager.

publicKeyAlias.description: Vault alias of the shared public key (Terraform's `publickey_alias`, "<participantName>-pub") used by data-plane and identity-hub. Not used by telemetry-agent, whose public key alias is derived from `global.identityHub.didWebUrl`.

aesKeyAlias.description: Vault alias of the shared AES key (Terraform's `aes_key_alias`, "<participantName>-aes") used to encrypt participant-context config. Required since EDC 0.16.0's encryption-algorithm registry (`edc.encryption.aes.key.alias`). Used by control-plane, data-plane, identity-hub, and telemetry-agent.

didWebUrl.description: This participant's Identity Hub DID Web URL.
The dataspace authority's DID Web URL.

url.description: Hashicorp Vault URL shared by all components.

enabled.description: Enables OpenTelemetry (javaagent, OTLP exporter, prometheus metrics endpoint 9464, and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES) on the control-plane, data-plane, and identity-hub. The telemetry-agent is not instrumented, matching the Terraform reference.

collectorEndpoint.description: OTLP collector gRPC endpoint (Terraform's opentelemetry_collector_endpoint). Required when telemetry.enabled is true.

route.description: OpenShift routes (rendered as Ingress resources) reproducing Terraform's per-component kubernetes_ingress_v1 resources for control-plane, data-plane, and identity-hub.

enabled.description: Enable rendering of the OpenShift routes.

hostPattern.description: printf host pattern with two %s verbs (participantName, componentToken), Terraform's oc_route_pattern. Required when route.enabled is true.

className.description: Ingress class name applied to every route (Terraform's ingress_class_name).

clusterIssuer.description: cert-manager cluster issuer annotation for the control-plane, data-plane, and identity-hub routes.
